title: NVIDIA launches RTX Spark laptops with Blackwell RTX graphics
excerpt: The new Windows PCs feature up to 128GB of unified memory and are priced starting at $2,399.
bodyHtml:
NVIDIA announced on October 17, 2026, that RTX Spark laptops are available for purchase. These devices, produced by manufacturers including ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI, are designed to support local AI, content creation and gaming.

The laptops utilize a superchip that combines an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU and an NVIDIA Grace CPU. This hardware configuration provides up to 1 petaflop of AI compute and up to 128GB of unified memory. The systems are available in slim, premium Windows PCs.

NVIDIA held launch events in six cities worldwide to demonstrate the capabilities of the new systems. These locations included Berlin, Beijing, Istanbul, Seoul, San Francisco and Taipei. At the Berlin event, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang made a surprise appearance to greet attendees and distribute signed laptops.

Developers and AI enthusiasts can access resources for running local AI on the new hardware. NVIDIA provides tested recipes and playbooks for users to explore the capabilities of the RTX Spark platform.
